title: From Supabase to Clerk to Better Auth
summary: Val Town engineers share their experience migrating from Supabase Auth to Clerk, detailing the pain points with Supabase's cookie-based authentication and how Clerk provided better DX with middleware support, simplified user management, and a more reliable email deliverability system.
problem_solved: Val Town needed a more developer-friendly and reliable authentication solution that handles edge cases like serverless environments and multi-device sessions better than Supabase Auth.
why_valuable: This case study offers practical insights and code examples for teams considering authentication provider migrations, with real metrics on email deliverability and user management improvements.
